newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies 190 for six v Australia A.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies 190 for six v Australia A.

text.p: Shivnarine Chanderpaul fell to a diving outfield catch by Michael DiVenuto for 72 for West Indies to be 190 for six in the limited overs match against Australia A at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on Friday.
Chanderpaul was the highest scorer for West Indies before he fell to an excellent catch by by DiVenuto from the bowling of Michael Kasprowicz in the 45th over.
Chanderpaul and acting West Indies captain Brian Lara had put on 70 for the fourth wicket after West Indies had been in trouble on 44 for three.
Jimmy Adams was 14 not out and the new batsman was Curtly Ambrose.
